semiconductor_relevance: High — Optifab, Inc. operates optical wafer fabs that produce photonic integrated circuits, which are critical for advanced semiconductor applications.
summary: Optifab, Inc. specializes in manufacturing optical wafers that integrate thin-film lithium niobate and silicon photonics technologies. Their facilities in Taiwan produce photonic integrated circuits for applications in AI, space laser communications, and quantum computing, streamlining the development cycle from materials to packaging.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Optifab operates four in-house optical wafer fabs in Taiwan, focusing on advanced photonic technologies.
